properties.name: ColumnWidths
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the specified column widths as a `string` using Fortran-esque fixed-format specifications. 


This is equivalent to the “User-Defined” format specifier for External Data as described in the product 
documentation. 


Note, however, that regardless of the format specifier all imported columns WILL be interpreted using the 
.NET command `double.TryParse()` to support the requirements of the underlying variable data for Table. 


In the example below, the line has one integer followed by four exponential data types. 
385 8.333333333E-003 9.375000000E-003 3.375000000E-001 0.000000000E+000 
The corresponding format is `1i3,4e17.9` 
Where: 
The first entry is the number of occurrences
The second entry is the format specifier
The third entry is the number of characters of data in the definition(including numeric values (0-9), 
the letter 'e' (for instances of scientific notation), and any white space and + or - signs) 
The fourth entry is the number of digits after the decimal point.

Add a column to be imported from the specified data source column index and configured
as the specified variable type. The order in which columns are added determines their
order in the data imported to .


If unit is `null`, the default unit (in the active unit system) for the specified
variable type will be assumed during import.


If name is `null` or empty, a unique name will be generated from the specified
variableType during import.


A reference to the instance is returned so that invocations can be chained together.

properties.name: ColumnWidths
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the specified column widths.
When setting, The value provided to  may be either:

  
    A `string` using Fortran-esque fixed-format specifications. This is similar to the
    “User-Defined” format specifier for External Data as described in the product
    documentation. Note, however, that regardless of the format specifier all imported
    columns WILL be interpreted using the .NET command `double.TryParse()` to support
    the requirements of the underlying variable data for Table.
  
  
    An  containing the widths of each column. Negative
    values may be specified to define a negated width, meaning ‘-2’ would be equivalent
    to the fixed-width string specification ’2X’.

RigidBodyTransformationMatrix.name: RigidBodyTransformationMatrix
RigidBodyTransformationMatrix.doc:
A 4x4 transformation matrix, to be used explicitly for rigid body transformations. The
transformation matrix is in column-major format. Elements 0-3 represent, respectively,
the x-components of the X axis, Y axis, Z axis, and translation with respect to global.
Identically, elements 4-7 represent the y components and elements 8-11 the z components.
Elements 2-15, per rigid-body requirements, are expected to be [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0].

The ability to piecewise set rotation and translation components precludes the option of
validating the matrix data at every operation. Thus, these values ***must*** be checked
before the data is used.

The class `Ansys.ACT.Common.SimpleTransform` provides a simplified mechanism for working
with rigid body transformations and getting a `RigidBodyTransformationMatrix` object.

methods.name: IsMatrixWellFormed
methods.doc:
Verify that the data meets the following criteria for a rigid-body transformation:
  1) The rotation matrix contains three orthonormal orientations
  2) The transformation components are valid values
  3) The shear components are all zero
  4) The scale value is unity

properties.name: Data
properties.doc: A 16-value list representing a linearized 4x4 transformation matrix.

properties.name: X_x
properties.doc: Element 0: the x component of the X axis rotation.

properties.name: X_y
properties.doc: Element 4: the y component of the X axis rotation.

properties.name: X_z
properties.doc: Element 8: the z component of the X axis rotation.

properties.name: Y_x
properties.doc: Element 1: the x component of the Y axis rotation.

properties.name: Y_y
properties.doc: Element 5: the y component of the Y axis rotation.

properties.name: Y_z
properties.doc: Element 9: the z component of the Y axis rotation.

properties.name: Z_x
properties.doc: Element 2: the x component of the Z axis rotation.

properties.name: Z_y
properties.doc: Element 6: the y component of the Z axis rotation.

properties.name: Z_z
properties.doc: Element 10: the z component of the Z axis rotation.

properties.name: T_x
properties.doc: Element 3: the x component of the translation.

properties.name: T_y
properties.doc: Element 7: the y component of the translation.

properties.name: T_z
properties.doc: Element 11: the z component of the translation.

properties.name: tau_x
properties.doc:
Element 12: the x component of the shear, which must be '0.0' for rigid body
transformations.

properties.name: tau_y
properties.doc:
Element 13: the y component of the shear, which must be '0.0' for rigid body
transformations.

properties.name: tau_z
properties.doc:
Element 14: the z component of the shear, which must be '0.0' for rigid body
transformations.

properties.name: S
properties.doc:
Element 15: the transformation scale, which must be '1.0' for rigid body
transformations.

IdentifierType.name: IdentifierType
IdentifierType.doc:
The primary identifier to use when searching for existing materials. The name and the uuid must
always be unique across all materials in the database.  There can be
Name        UUID
material1   DEA8407F-4029-4919-94F0-5BDC6FBF203A
material2   7ED99748-4885-4AAA-8600-CE21253325FA

but not  (same name different UUID)
material1   DEA8407F-4029-4919-94F0-5BDC6FBF203A
material1   7ED99748-4885-4AAA-8600-CE21253325FA

or  (different name same UUID)
material1   DEA8407F-4029-4919-94F0-5BDC6FBF203A
material2   DEA8407F-4029-4919-94F0-5BDC6FBF203A

The reason to use this is if the name of the material changed for a "refresh" (search by UUID) or if the UUID
needs changed (search by Name).  Either way a material cannot be added which would violate the above rules.

GeometryImportPreferences.name: GeometryImportPreferences
GeometryImportPreferences.doc:
This is used to provide import and reload (refresh) preferences for geometry file import.
These preferences are identical to those exposed in the WB2 project schematic and Mechanical
Geometry preferences. More information can be found in the “Geometry Preferences” section of
the “CAD Integration” documentation. Both general and advanced preferences are provided.



Default values will be taken from the Mechanical preferences. This allows user-specified
default values to propagate to these preferences.

methods.name: GetScriptedPropertySetter
methods.doc:
Get a string containing script-executable commands to set the properties on a
preferences instance preferencesToChange, with the scripted name
variableName, to match the properties on another preferences instance
preferencesToMirror. Only the properties that are different will be used.

Multiple semicolon-delimited filters may be specified. An empty string matches

The default value is Source meaning that the facets as represented in the CAD 
system or use a Normal option for those that do not have display. 
The others are relative settings compared to "normal" facet quality. 
Typically, better facet quality requires more memory and may take additional time to import/update.

The standard unit systems are used in the mechanical UI. (From the toolbar menu "Unit"). Be aware that the standard unit systems are NOT consistent.
The consistent unit systems are mostly used in the solver.

properties.name: ControlType
properties.doc: Returns the type of the control.

properties.name: EnableCheckpoint
properties.doc: Flag whether to enable a checkpoint or not. The default value is false.

properties.name: InnerScopeOutcome
properties.doc: If the InnerScopeDefinition is set to Outcome, then this property is visible. It defines the previous step outcome. This way we input the results of a previous step to the current step. The input applies to inner region of enclosure.

properties.name: ExternalScopeOutcome
properties.doc: If the InnerScopeDefinition is set to Outcome, then this property is visible. It defines the previous step outcome. This way we input the results of a previous step to the current step. The input applies to inner region of enclosure.

properties.name: ScopeOutcome
properties.doc: If the InnerScopeDefinition is set to Outcome, then this property is visible. It defines the previous step outcome. This way we input the results of a previous step to the current step. The input applies to inner region of enclosure.

properties.name: ScopeDefinition
properties.doc: It is defined by value or outcome.

properties.name: InnerScopeDefinition
properties.doc: It is defined by value or outcome depending on if the Inner scope is defined manually by the user or defined based on a previous outcome.

properties.name: InnerScopeMethod
properties.doc: The method can be label/zone/part and it is applied to inner region of enclosure.

properties.name: ExternalScopeDefinition
properties.doc: It is defined by value or outcome depending on if the External scope is defined manual by the user or defined based on a previous outcome.

properties.name: ExternalScopeMethod
properties.doc: The method can be label/zone/part and it is applied to external region of enclosure.

properties.name: SurfaceMeshType
properties.doc: This property gives control over what type of elements need to be generated in the mesh. The supported surface mesh types are Triangles and Quadrilaterals.

properties.name: MeshFlowControl
properties.doc: This property gives control over the flow of mesh during surface mesh generation. The supported modes are None, and Global Cartesian.

properties.name: TriangleCountReductionMode
properties.doc: This property gives control over the mode/degree of triangle count reduction during surface mesh generation. The supported modes are None, Conservative and Aggressive.

properties.name: VolumeMeshType
properties.doc: Type of Volume elements such as Tetrahedrons and Hex.

properties.name: CenterPosition
properties.doc: It is defined by “Centered”, “Minimal”, and “User Defined”.

properties.name: RegionType
properties.doc: It is defined by Material Point or External.

properties.name: MaterialPointType
properties.doc: It defines the type of material point, it can be “Include” or “Exclude”.

properties.name: MaterialPointDefinition
properties.doc: Gets or sets the material point definition type.

properties.name: CoordinateSystem
properties.doc: Gets or sets the Coordinate System object used to define the material point location.

properties.name: VerticalizeTargetNormal
properties.doc: This property defines the target normal direction for the faces during verticalization. The available options are XPlus, YPlus, ZPlus, XMinus, YMinus, ZMinus.

properties.name: DeleteEmptyVolumes
properties.doc: This property is used to enable or disable the automatic deletion of empty topo volumes  during mesh to topology conversion. The default value is false.

properties.name: MaterialName
properties.doc: Gets or sets the Material Name.

properties.name: SizeFieldName
properties.doc: This property is used to define the name of the size field to apply to the meshing operation.

properties.name: CreateQuads
properties.doc: This property is used to define the name of the size field to apply to the meshing operation.

properties.name: PrescribedPointsFileName
properties.doc: Gets or sets the path to the file containing the prescribed points locations. The data must be in csv format.

properties.name: ControlScopeDefinition
properties.doc: It is defined by value or outcome.

properties.name: FixedScopeDefinition
properties.doc: It is defined by value or outcome.

properties.name: RigidScopeDefinition
properties.doc: It is defined by value or outcome.

properties.name: MorphableScopeDefinition
properties.doc: It is defined by value or outcome.

properties.name: SourceScopeDefinition
properties.doc: It is defined by value or outcome.

properties.name: TargetScopeDefinition
properties.doc: It is defined by value or outcome.

properties.name: InternalObject
properties.doc: Gets the internal object. For advanced usage only.

properties.name: Thickness
properties.doc: Gets or sets the Thickness to be assigned to the scoped zone.

properties.name: AutoQuad_HoleOffsetPercentage
properties.doc: Gets or sets the hole offset percentage to be used with mesh size when generating quad layers.

properties.name: ExternalScopePattern
properties.doc: The value can be a name of a region or a predefined patterns to select multiple region names.

properties.name: InnerScopePattern
properties.doc: The value can be a name of a region or a predefined patterns to select multiple region names.

properties.name: SmoothingIterations
properties.doc: Allows user to input number of iterations needed to achieve good mesh results.

properties.name: NumberOfVolumetricLayers
properties.doc: Allows user to input number of volumetric layers of the enclosure.

properties.name: MinimalNumberOfVolumetricLayers
properties.doc: It determines the minimal number of layers of volume elements to be created around the scoped body.

properties.name: ExternalLabelName
properties.doc: This property is used to rename the default external label name generated during execution of step.

properties.name: InternalLabelName
properties.doc: This property is used to rename the default Internal label name generated during execution of step.

properties.name: EdgeLabelName
properties.doc: This property is used to rename the default edge label name generated during execution of step.

properties.name: ExcludeScopePattern
properties.doc: Gets or sets the part, zone or label name pattern for the Hole Patching exclusion scoping. Applicable only if scope is defined by value.

properties.name: NumberOfLayers
properties.doc: Number of layers of mesh elements.

properties.name: FaceZoneName
properties.doc: This property is used to define the name of the default face zone name generated during execution of step.

properties.name: Filename
properties.doc: Assign full path to the filename would like to Import/Export.

properties.name: Filenames
properties.doc: Assign paths with ‘|’ seperator to this property to read multiple files, pass without seperator if single file.

properties.name: NumberOfAttempts
properties.doc: Number of attempts for mesh convergence.

properties.name: LabelCreationExpression
properties.doc: Gets or sets the expression set algebra expression used in a LabelCreationByExpression control.

properties.name: LabelCreationExpressionSymbol
properties.doc: Gets or sets the expression symbol associated to entities identified by a label creation control. These symbols can be referenced in a LabelCreationByExpression control to create labels based on expressions. Valid symbols do not contain whitespaces or any of the following characters "&, |, ^, !, (, )".

properties.name: LabelName
properties.doc: This property is used to rename the default label name generated during execution of step.

properties.name: EdgeBiasingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the MultiZone Mesher edge sizing biasing factor.

properties.name: InflationGrowthRate
properties.doc: Gets or sets gradient of layer height.

properties.name: InflationInitialHeight
properties.doc: Gets or sets the height of the first inflation layer.

properties.name: InflationNumberOfLayers
properties.doc: Gets or sets the number of inflation layers.

properties.name: NumberOfRadialDivisions
properties.doc: Gets or sets the number of radial divisions to apply to scoped faces having two concentric boundary loops.

properties.name: MeshedVolumeLabelSuffix
properties.doc: Gets or sets the suffix to be used when defining labels scoped to volumes meshed by the MultiZone mesher.

properties.name: ReverseEdgeBiasingDirection
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether the Multizone Mesher edge biasing direction should be reversed.

properties.name: SharedTopologyLabelName
properties.doc: Gets or sets the name used as label to scope the shared topology faces which are automatically added as input mesh for MultiZone.

properties.name: NumberOfDivisions
properties.doc: Gets or sets the number of divisions for the scoped edges.

properties.name: PartName
properties.doc: This property allows user to rename the default part name generated during wrap operation.

properties.name: PercentageIncrement
properties.doc: The number of volumetric Layers determines the number of layers. This property decides whether all the layers are an equal size (default 0.0) or they should gradually increase the size of volume element than previous element.

properties.name: MorphRecordingName
properties.doc: This property is used to define the name for matching the morphing recording to apply to the meshing operation.

properties.name: ScaleFactor
properties.doc: Scale Factor is used to scale shapes in different dimensions.

properties.name: ScopePattern
properties.doc: The value can be a name of a region or a predefined patterns to select multiple region names.

properties.name: ElementsPerGap
properties.doc: Gets or sets the minimum number of element layers to be generated per gap for the Proximity Sizing control. The default values is 3.

properties.name: SizeFieldPattern
properties.doc: This property is used to define the name pattern for matching the size fields to apply to the meshing operation.

properties.name: BaseFaceLabel
properties.doc: Defines the label to be used for the base face.

properties.name: DirectionX
properties.doc: Defines x component of stacking direction to be used in stacker steps.

properties.name: DirectionY
properties.doc: Defines y component of stacking direction to be used in stacker steps.

properties.name: DirectionZ
properties.doc: Defines z component of stacking direction to be used in stacker steps.

properties.name: SeedFaceScopePattern
properties.doc: Gets or sets the part, zone or label name pattern that defines the scope. Applicable only if scope is defined by value.

properties.name: SeedFaceScopeOutcome
properties.doc: Gets or sets the scope outcome from a previous operation. Applicable only if scope is defined by outcome.

properties.name: BaseFaceScopePattern
properties.doc: Gets or sets the part, zone or label name pattern that defines the scope. Applicable only if scope is defined by value.

properties.name: BaseFaceScopeOutcome
properties.doc: Gets or sets the scope outcome from a previous operation. Applicable only if scope is defined by outcome.

properties.name: QuadBoundaryLayerFaceScopeOutcome
properties.doc: Gets or sets the scope outcome from a previous operation. Applicable only if scope is defined by outcome.

properties.name: QuadBoundaryLayerFaceScopePattern
properties.doc: Gets or sets the part, zone or label name pattern that defines the scope. Applicable only if scope is defined by value.

properties.name: QuadBoundaryLayerGrowthRate
properties.doc: Gets or sets the ratio of heights between adjacent quad layers.

properties.name: QuadBoundaryLayerNumberOfDivisions
properties.doc: Gets or sets the number of divisions on the washer boundary from where the quad layers are grown.

properties.name: QuadBoundaryLayerNumberOfLayers
properties.doc: Gets or sets the number of quad layers on the washer boundary.

properties.name: TargetSkewness
properties.doc: Set Limit to the skewness of an element. Higher the skewness value, expecting a better mesh result.

properties.name: GrowthRate
properties.doc: Gradient of element size as each layer grows.

properties.name: VolumeZoneName
properties.doc: This property is used to rename the default volume zone name generated during execution of step.

properties.name: IntersectingTopoFaceTolerance
properties.doc: Gets or sets the minimum angle used in finding thin stripes with advanced topology diagnostics.

properties.name: OverlappingTopoFaceTolerance
properties.doc: Gets or sets the tolerance for the minimum overlap distance used in finding overlapping topology faces with advanced topology diagnostics.

properties.name: SmallTopoEdgesLength
properties.doc: Gets or sets the max edge length used in finding small topo edges with advanced topology diagnostics.

properties.name: ThinStripesWidth
properties.doc: Gets or sets the max width used in finding thin stripes with advanced topology diagnostics.

properties.name: AutoQuad_FragmentedEdgeTolerance
properties.doc: Gets or sets the edge tolerance for non circular holes with round corners in order to remove the short edge and hotspots when treating holes and features.

properties.name: AutoQuad_MeshSize
properties.doc: Gets or sets the maximum size for the mesh.

properties.name: AutoQuad_ThinStripesTolerance
properties.doc: Gets or sets the maximum thin stripe width to be used when defeaturing topology.

properties.name: AutoQuad_ZoneThickness
properties.doc: Gets or sets the Zone Thickness to be used when converting an all quad mesh to splines.

properties.name: ConnectionSize
properties.doc: Gets or sets the edge mesh size used to check the connection.

properties.name: ConnectionTolerance
properties.doc: Gets or sets the maximum gap for the connection.

properties.name: CoplanarAngleTolerance
properties.doc: Gets or sets the angle below which the faces are considered coplanar.

properties.name: ElementSize
properties.doc: Define element size to achieve desired mesh results. User can achieve coarse, medium, or fine mesh by varying this value.

properties.name: CenterPlaneNormalOffset
properties.doc: It defines the desired offset of the plane of the hemisphere from the model.

properties.name: MinimalRadius
properties.doc: It defines the desired minimal radius of the spherical enclosure.

properties.name: TrimDistance
properties.doc: Gets or sets the distance for the mesh based trim.

properties.name: ConstantHeight
properties.doc: Height of a single layer of mesh elements.

properties.name: DihedralAngle
properties.doc: The dihedral angle is the angle between the normal vectors of two element faces.

properties.name: MaxHoleSize
properties.doc: Gets or sets the maximum size of holes to be considered for Wrapper Leak Prevention and Hole Patching.

properties.name: MergeNodesTolerance
properties.doc: Defines the tolerance within which nodes are to be merged.

properties.name: DefeatureTolerance
properties.doc: Gets or sets the defeature tolerance applied during meshing.

properties.name: SweepingSize
properties.doc: Gets or sets the constant size along the sweeping direction.

properties.name: ProximityRadius
properties.doc: Gets or sets the radius for the proximity based search.

properties.name: FeatureAngle
properties.doc: Gets or sets the angle not to be exceeded when performing repairs. Must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 180 degrees.

properties.name: PinchTolerance
properties.doc: Gets or sets the largest tolerance to be used when removing small features.

properties.name: RepairTolerance
properties.doc: Gets or sets the tolerance value to be used to reduce variability of output topology, prevent the collapse and defeature of thin or short topologies, and allow the creation of a coarse mesh while keeping topology as-is.

properties.name: SharpAngle
properties.doc: Gets or sets the maximum angle between faces to be merged. Must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 30 degrees.

properties.name: ShortEdgeLength
properties.doc: Gets or sets the maximum edge length to be collapsed.

properties.name: ThinFaceWidth
properties.doc: Gets or sets the maximum thin face width to be merged.

properties.name: MaxSize
properties.doc: Gets or sets the maximum size to be used for the volumetric size field sizing computation in the Proximity Sizing and Curvature Sizing controls. This is a length value.

properties.name: MinSize
properties.doc: Gets or sets the minimum size to be used for the volumetric size field sizing computation in the Proximity Sizing and Curvature Sizing controls. This is a length value.

properties.name: NormalAngle
properties.doc: Gets or sets the maximum allowed normal angle between neighboring elements when computing curvature for the Curvature Sizing control. This value must be between 0 and 180 degrees (0 to π) and defaults to 18 degrees.

properties.name: LateralDefeatureTolerance
properties.doc: Defines defeature tolerance to be used along the lateral direction of stacking.

properties.name: OriginX
properties.doc: Defines x coordinate of origin (location of base face) in the base face creation step.

properties.name: OriginY
properties.doc: Defines y coordinate of origin (location of base face) in the base face creation step.

properties.name: OriginZ
properties.doc: Defines z coordinate of origin (location of base face) in the base face creation step.

properties.name: DefaultOffsetSize
properties.doc: Defines size of the offset layers to be used during the stack base operation.

properties.name: StackingDefeatureTolerance
properties.doc: Defines defeature tolerance to be used along the stacking direction.

properties.name: QuadBoundaryLayerFirstLayerHeight
properties.doc: Gets or sets the height of the first quad layer.

properties.name: ConnectIntersectionType
properties.doc: Gets or sets the connect intersection type. The default value is AllToAll.

properties.name: ControlDataDefinition
properties.doc: This property is used to define if the control data is defined by value or by settings.

properties.name: CoordinatesDefinition
properties.doc: Gets or sets the location coordinates definition type. The default value is Location.

properties.name: HemisphereCenterModality
properties.doc: This property is used to define the rule for the computation of the center of the hemispherical enclosure.

properties.name: HemisphereOrientationModality
properties.doc: This property is used to define the rule for the computation of the orientation of the hemispherical enclosure.

properties.name: SphereCenterModality
properties.doc: This property is used to define the rule for the computation of the center of the spherical enclosure.

properties.name: TrimElementSelectionType
properties.doc: Gets or sets the trim element selection type. The default value is Outside.

properties.name: ExcludeScopeMethod
properties.doc: Gets or sets the scoping method for the Hole Patching exclusion scoping. Default: Label.

properties.name: ExcludeScopeDefinition
properties.doc: Gets or sets the type of scope definition for the Hole Patching exclusion scoping. Default: Value

properties.name: MeshEntityType
properties.doc: Gets or sets the target mesh entity type. The default value is Face.

properties.name: EdgeBiasingType
properties.doc: Specifies the type of biasing to apply along the scoped edges.

properties.name: DecompositionType
properties.doc: Specifies the decomposition type used by the MultiZone mesher.

properties.name: DefeatureToleranceDefineBy
properties.doc: Specifies how the Defeature Tolerance is defined for the MultiZone mesher.

properties.name: EdgeBiasingDefineBy
properties.doc: Specifies how the scoped edges meshing size is defined.

properties.name: FreeFaceMeshType
properties.doc: Specifies the type of elements for the MultiZone mesher free face mesh.

properties.name: SemistructuredPatternType
properties.doc: Specifies the Semistructured Pattern type used by the MultiZone Mapped Meshing control.

properties.name: TrimOperationType
properties.doc: Gets or sets the trim operation type. The default value is Trim.

properties.name: SizeFieldDefinition
properties.doc: Gets or sets how the control's size field pattern should be defined, either by "Value" or by "Outcome". The default value is "Value".

properties.name: SeedFaceScopeMethod
properties.doc: Gets or sets the scoping method for the seed face scoping. Default: Label.

properties.name: SeedFaceScopeDefinition
properties.doc: Gets or sets the type of scope definition for the seed face scoping. Default: Value

properties.name: BaseFaceScopeMethod
properties.doc: Gets or sets the scoping method for the base face scoping. Default: Label.

properties.name: BaseFaceScopeDefinition
properties.doc: Gets or sets the type of scope definition for the base face scoping. Default: Value

properties.name: QuadBoundaryLayerFaceScopeDefinition
properties.doc: Gets or sets the type of scope definition for the quad boundary layer face scoping. Default: Value

properties.name: QuadBoundaryLayerFaceScopeMethod
properties.doc: Gets or sets the scoping method for the quad boundary layer face scoping. Default: Label.

properties.name: AutoQuad_AllowCurvedTopoFaces
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to allow curved topo faces when detecting and treating holes.

properties.name: AutoQuad_SplitTopoEdgesAtApexPoint
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to split topo edges at their apex point when repairing topology.

properties.name: AutoCollapseShortEdges
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to collapse edges below the specified tolerance. Feature edges and Protected edges are not collapsed.

properties.name: AutoDeleteInteriorNodes
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to delete interior nodes from scoped topology.

properties.name: AutoPartialDefeature
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to partially remove thin faces and sharp angles within provided tolerances, such that only topology impacting mesh quality is removed.

properties.name: AutoPinchFaces
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to remove small features from topology to improve mesh quality.

properties.name: AutoRemoveSharpAngleFaces
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to remove sharp angle faces below the specified angle tolerance by merging them to the neighboring faces.

properties.name: AutoRemoveThinFaces
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to remove thin faces by merging them with the neighboring faces.

properties.name: AutoRepairTopoEdgesOfTopoFaces
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to prevent the collapse and defeature of thin or short topologies, and allow the creation of a coarse mesh while keeping topology as-is.

properties.name: AutoSuppressInteriorEdges
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to suppress interior edges of scoped faces.

properties.name: MergeOverlappingFaces
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to merge overlapping faces after connect. The default value is false.

properties.name: AutomaticExternalScope
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to define programmatically the external scoping method and pattern for the external enclosure. The default value is false.

properties.name: SmoothingPreserveVolume
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to enable and disable the volume preserving smoothing. If enabled, the smoothing will preserve the initial volume of the input. The default value is false.

properties.name: CreateFaceZone
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to create a new face zone.

properties.name: CreateQuadraticElements
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to create quadratic elements. The default value is false.

properties.name: ProjectSideFaces
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to project the side faces after the extrusion.

properties.name: TopologyConformalConnection
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to preserve the topology connection for the newly created faces. The default value is false.

properties.name: RestrictBoundaryNodes
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to restrict the boundary nodes displacement. The default value is true.

properties.name: ApplySemistructuredPattern
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to apply Semistructured Pattern mapped meshing.

properties.name: PreserveBoundary
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to preserve the boundary or not. If true, adding a prescribed point which causes a deformation of the volume boundary will result in a failure.

properties.name: AppendData
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to append the mesh data being read to the current PrimeMesh model or to clear the model content before the mesh data is being read. The default value is false.

properties.name: RecomputeClosedVolumes
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to recompute closed volumes after the operation.

properties.name: RepairModel
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to repair the PrimeMesh model after the reading operation is executed. The default value is false.

properties.name: IgnoreOrientation
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to ignore the face normal orientation while calculating the proximity for the Proximity Sizing control. The default value is False.

properties.name: IgnoreSelfProximity
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to ignore the proximity between two faces from the same face zone while calculating the proximity for the Proximity Sizing control. The default value is True.

properties.name: SkipInteractiveSession
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to skip the interactive session on execution. The default value is false.

properties.name: ConformalMeshOnContactSurfaces
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to make the contact boundaries of the input bodies conformal. The default value is true.

properties.name: AddUniqueLabelPerPoint
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to apply a unique label name to each added prescribed point. Uniqueness is enforced by appending a numbering suffix to the label name.

properties.name: Remesh
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to allow the remesh of already meshed volumes. The default value is false.

properties.name: DeleteInputScope
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to delete of input scope after wrapping. The default value is false.

properties.name: ExcludeEnclosure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to exclude the enclosure from the wrapper scope . The default value is false.

properties.name: FaceZoneByPart
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to define an independent face zone for each input part.

properties.name: ReverseSurfaceOrientation
properties.doc: Reverse Surface Orientation. The default value is false.

properties.name: WrapByParts
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether to wrap each part separately. The default value is false.

properties.name: ExcludeScopeOutcome
properties.doc: Gets or sets the scope outcome from a previous operation for the Hole Patching exclusion scoping. Applicable only if scope is defined by outcome.

properties.name: SizeFieldOutcome
properties.doc: Gets or sets the outcome to be used to define the size field pattern when SizeFieldDefinition is set to "Outcome".

methods.name: DeleteAllStepsAndClearGeneratedData
methods.doc: Deletes all steps and reset workflow type to undefined and also resets all inactive geometry parts/bodies to active again, clears the output data, and resets the state of the child objects (“Input”, “Steps”, “Output”) to the initial state. However, any user-defined settings such as the “Input” node scoping are retained.

methods.name: PropagateSettings

methods.name: DeleteSettings

methods.name: ExecuteUpToStep

methods.name: ClearGeneratedData

However, any user-defined settings such as the “Input” node scoping are retained.

methods.doc: Clears only the "Output" data, i.e., the generated Geometry part(s) and the associated mesh.

methods.name: FinalizeWorkflow

methods.name: InitializeWorkflow
methods.doc: Initializes the mesh workflow by transferring the scoped geometry parts/bodies from Mechanical into the PrimeMesh model and updates the “Input” node state accordingly.

MeshExtrude.doc: Pull method enables you to extrude or revolve element faces, topofaces or scoped bodies (only shell body) from a surface or solid mesh. Pull also allows to create surface coating on solid bodies, element faces and topofaces.

properties.doc: Allows you to scope elements, element faces, topofaces and sheet bodies for Extrude or Revolve. Also, scopes element faces, topofaces and solid bodies for Surface Coating.

properties.name: InternalObject
properties.doc: Gets the internal object. For advanced usage only.

properties.name: Material
properties.doc: To select the material of your choice. You can also select a different material from the parent body material.

properties.name: NumberOfLayers
properties.doc: To specify the number of layers to be used for Extrude and Revolve.

properties.name: Height
properties.doc: To specify the height for the volume of solid elements in the method of Extrude.

properties.name: RevolutionAngle
properties.doc: To specify angle of revolution for the solid elements in the method of Revolve.

properties.name: FeatureAngle
properties.doc: To specify feature angle for splitting side faces.

properties.name: Thickness
properties.doc: To specify the thickness for surface coating. The Thickness option is available only when the Stiffness Behavior is set to Membrane Only or Membrane and Bending.

properties.name: AxisOfRevolution
properties.doc: To select the coordinate axis along which the selected elements can be revolved. The available options are X Axis, Y Axis, Z Axis.

properties.name: ExtrudeBy
properties.doc: To specify the method of Extrude. The available options are Use Coordinate System and Face Normal.

properties.name: UseCoordinateSystem
properties.doc: The Use Coordinate System allows to select any of the XYZ coordinate axis in the method of Extrude.

properties.name: Method
properties.doc: To select the method of Pull. There are three methods. They are Extrude, Revolve and Surface Coating.

properties.name: StiffnessOption
properties.doc: To provide the stiffness option of the shell body created by surface coating. The available options are Stress Evaluation Only, Membrane Only, Membrane and Bending.

properties.name: UpTo
properties.doc: To generate elements up to the specified target. The target can be faces from solids or sheet bodies and multiple faces with sharing topoedge.

properties.name: MergeProfileNodes
properties.doc: To merge nodes on the profile body and pull generated body.

properties.name: Suppressed
properties.doc: To suppress the selected entities. You can select Yes to suppress the selected entities and No to unsuppress the selected entities. The default value is No.

properties.name: UseFeatureAngle
properties.doc: To split side faces by speficied feature angle.

properties.name: CoordinateSystem
properties.doc: To generate elements in the specified coordinate system. The Coordinate System allows to select the Global Coordinate System by default.

properties.name: UpToTarget
properties.doc: The target can be faces from solids or sheet bodies and multiple faces with sharing topoedge in Extrude UpTo.

methods.name: CreateCylindricalBolt
methods.doc:
Create bolt with a cylinder head based on the specified dimensions. The bolt will be
created so that the base of the head is at the origin and aligned with the Y-Z plane.
Valid input arguments include:
  1) `double`
  2) `Quantity`
  3) A string representation of `double` or `Quantity`, i.e., "1.0" or "1.0 [cm]"

methods.name: CreateCylindricalNut
methods.doc:
Create a cylindrical nut with the specified dimensions. The nut will be created so that
the base of the nut is at the origin and aligned with the Y-Z plane.
Valid input arguments include:
  1) `double`
  2) `Quantity`
  3) A string representation of `double` or `Quantity`, i.e., "1.0" or "1.0 [cm]"

methods.name: CreateHexBolt
methods.doc:
Create a bolt with a hex head based on the specified dimensions. The bolt will be
created so that the base of the head is at the origin and aligned with the Y-Z plane.
Valid input arguments include:
  1) `double`
  2) `Quantity`
  3) A string representation of `double` or `Quantity`, i.e., "1.0" or "1.0 [cm]"

methods.name: CreateHexNut
methods.doc:
Create a hex nut with the specified dimensions. The nut will be created so that the
base of the nut is at the origin and aligned with the Y-Z plane.
Valid input arguments include:
  1) `double`
  2) `Quantity`
  3) A string representation of `double` or `Quantity`, i.e., "1.0" or "1.0 [cm]"

methods.name: SetTransformationOnPart

Transform a part with given transformation. Only rigid body transformation is

emitted if the matrix is ill-formed.

methods.name: CreateAndAddColumn
methods.doc:
Creates and adds a new column (data series) to the table.

If `data` is provided, the number of rows (length of `data`) must be identical to the
number of rows already in the table. If `data` is not provided, the returned series will
have the same number of rows as the table with default-initialized values. If there are
no rows in the table and `data` is provided, this will initialize the number of rows in
the table to the length of `data`.

methods.name: GetDataURI
methods.doc: Gets the data URI from which the tabular data was imported.

methods.name: GetImportSettings
methods.doc: Get the settings used for an import operation.

methods.name: Import
methods.doc:
Import data from the provided resource into the table as specified by
format and settings. The column definitions in
settings will be used to define the variable type for each column.
If the table already contains a variable type, that column will be overwritten by the
new definition.


When  is true,  will verify that the
row count of imported data are equivalent to the existing table row count. The
operation will fail if there is a length mismatch. Conversely, when
 is false, a Mechanical warning message will be issued when
any of the data sources are different from each other or the table.


If all the arguments are `null` (Python: `None`) then the stored values will be used,
essentially re-syncing the table data to the external sources.

methods.name: Add
methods.doc:
Adds a support or base removal step.
Throws a notSupportedException if the same step was already added.
Usage:
 removalSequence.Add(Ansys.ACT.Automation.Mechanical.AdditiveManufacturing.BaseRemoval())
 removalSequence.Add(Ansys.ACT.Automation.Mechanical.AdditiveManufacturing.SupportRemoval(supportObj))

methods.name: Remove
RemoveAt
methods.doc:
Remove AM step at index.
Throws IndexOutOfRangeException if index is out of range
Usage:
 removalSequence.RemoveAt(0)

methods.name: Swap
methods.doc:
Swaps two steps in the Removal sequence.
Returns true if successful and false if unsuccessful
Usage:
C#
 removalSequence.Swap(
    new Ansys.ACT.Automation.Mechanical.AdditiveManufacturing.BaseRemoval(),
    new Ansys.ACT.Automation.Mechanical.AdditiveManufacturing.SupportRemoval(supportObj));
Python
 removalSequence.Swap(
    Ansys.ACT.Automation.Mechanical.AdditiveManufacturing.BaseRemoval(),
    Ansys.ACT.Automation.Mechanical.AdditiveManufacturing.SupportRemoval(supportObj))

methods.name: IndexOf
Insert
methods.doc:
Inserts a given step at particular index(zero based)
Throws an IndexOutOfRangeException if the step is being inserted out of range.
Throws a NotSupportedException if the insertion is invalid
Usage:
 Sequence.Insert(0,Ansys.ACT.Automation.Mechanical.AdditiveManufacturing.UserStep())

FluidPenetrationPressure.name: FluidPenetrationPressure
FluidPenetrationPressure.doc:
A class for fluid penetration pressure object in Mechanical. This load object is used to simulate surrounding fluid or air penetrating into the contact interface.
        Users can apply this load to flexible-to-flexible or rigid-to-flexible contact pairs. This load object is available for static structural analysis.

properties.name: FilmCoefficient
properties.doc:
Property used to get and set the film coefficient data
The setter allows the use of a table  object, 
an expression contained in a string or a quantity  object as a data source.
Depending on the representation  type, 
the getter return type is a field  object or
an object which type depends on the source of the film coefficient data:
- On table assignment mode, it returns the source table  object.
- On function mode, it returns a string containing the expression evaluated to obtain the data.
- On constant mode, it returns a quantity  object containg the value and the units currently assigned to the film coefficient.
- On tabular mode, it returns a tabularDataTable  object.

properties.name: AmbientTemperature
properties.doc:
Property used to get and set the ambient temperature data
The setter allows the use of a table  object, 
an expression contained in a string or a quantity  object as a data source.
Depending on the representation  type, 
the getter return type is a field  object or
an object which type depends on the source of the ambient temperature data:
- On table assignment mode, it returns the source table  object.
- On function mode, it returns a string containing the expression evaluated to obtain the data.
- On constant mode, it returns a quantity  object containg the value and the units currently assigned to the ambient temperature.
- On tabular mode, it returns a tabularDataTable  object.

methods.name: ImportExternalDataFiles
methods.doc:
Imports external data files for current Imported Load Group.


This includes saving the external data files to project if specified, generating the XML representation 
of the external data settings, and updating the file association for mapping.


An ExternalDataFileCollection object can be created by calling the GetSettingsForFormat 
method from the factory class .

methods.name: GetExternalDataFiles
methods.doc:
Gets a copy of the most recently imported ExternalDataFileCollection. 
>

Returns an empty Collection if an ImportExternalData operation has never been done.
>

methods.name: ReloadExternalDataFiles
methods.doc: Reloads the external data files for current Imported Load Group.

CoreFailureSettings.name: CoreFailureSettings
CoreFailureSettings.doc: Defines the configuration for the Core failure criterion for sandwich structures.

methods.name: Reset
methods.doc: Resets the settings to their default values.

properties.name: WeightingFactor
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the weighting factor for the core failure criterion. The corresponding failure label
    is 'cf'.

properties.name: ConsiderInterlaminarNormalStresses
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether interlaminar normal stresses are included in the core failure evaluation.

CuntzeSettings.name: CuntzeSettings
CuntzeSettings.doc: Defines the configuration for the Cuntze failure criterion for reinforced materials.

methods.name: Reset
methods.doc: Resets the settings to their default values.

properties.name: FailureDimension
properties.doc:
Gets or sets whether the failure criterion is evaluated only in-plane (2D),
    or also in the out-of-plane direction (3D).

properties.name: EvaluateFiberTensionFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether fiber tension failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'cft'

properties.name: FiberTensionFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the fiber tension failure (cft) evaluation.

properties.name: EvaluateFiberCompressionFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether fiber compression failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'cfc'

properties.name: FiberCompressionFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the fiber compression failure (cfc) evaluation.

properties.name: EvaluateMatrixTensionFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether matrix tension failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'cmA'

properties.name: MatrixTensionFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the matrix tension failure (cmA) evaluation.

properties.name: EvaluateMatrixCompressionFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether matrix compression failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'cmB'

properties.name: MatrixCompressionFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the matrix compression failure (cmB) evaluation.

properties.name: EvaluateMatrixWedgeShapeFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether matrix wedge shape failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'cmC'

properties.name: MatrixWedgeShapeFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the matrix wedge shape failure (cmC) evaluation.

properties.name: ModeInteractionCoefficient
properties.doc: Gets or sets the mode interaction coefficient.

properties.name: InPlaneShearFrictionCoefficient
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the in-plane shear friction coefficient b21.
    The value must be greater than or equal to 0.

properties.name: OutOfPlaneShearFrictionCoefficient
properties.doc:
Gets the out-of-plane shear friction coefficient b32.
    Computed from the fracture plane angle theta.

properties.name: FracturePlaneAngle
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the fracture plane angle theta.
    The value must be in the range [45, 90).

FaceSheetWrinklingSettings.name: FaceSheetWrinklingSettings
FaceSheetWrinklingSettings.doc: Defines the configuration for the Face Sheet Wrinkling failure criterion for sandwich structures.

methods.name: Reset
methods.doc: Resets the settings to their default values.

properties.name: WeightingFactor
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the weighting factor for the face sheet wrinkling criterion. The corresponding failure
    label is 'wt' for wrinkling at the top face, 'wb' at the bottom face.

properties.name: HomogeneousCoreCoefficient
properties.doc: Gets or sets the wrinkling coefficient of homogeneous core materials.

properties.name: HoneycombCoreCoefficient
properties.doc: Gets or sets the wrinkling coefficient of honeycomb core materials.

HashinSettings.name: HashinSettings
HashinSettings.doc: Defines the configuration for the Hashin failure criterion for reinforced materials.

methods.name: Reset
methods.doc: Resets the settings to their default values.

properties.name: FailureDimension
properties.doc:
Gets or sets whether the failure criterion is evaluated only in-plane (2D),
    or also in the out-of-plane direction (3D).

properties.name: EvaluateFiberFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether fiber failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'hf'

properties.name: FiberFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the fiber failure evaluation.

properties.name: EvaluateMatrixFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether matrix failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'hm'

properties.name: MatrixFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the matrix failure evaluation.

properties.name: EvaluateDelamination
properties.doc:
Gets or sets whether delamination is evaluated. Only applies when three-dimensional
    evaluation is selected. The corresponding failure label is 'hd'

properties.name: DelaminationWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the delamination evaluation.

HoffmanSettings.name: HoffmanSettings
HoffmanSettings.doc: Defines the configuration for the Hoffman failure criterion for reinforced materials.

methods.name: Reset

properties.doc:

    Only used if OverrideMaterial is true.

properties.name: CompressiveLimitMaterialOneDirection
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the global compressive strain limit in the material 1 direction (eXc).
    Only used if OverrideMaterial is true.

properties.name: TensileLimitMaterialTwoDirection
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the global tensile strain limit in the material 2 direction (eYt).
    Only used if OverrideMaterial is true.

properties.name: CompressiveLimitMaterialTwoDirection
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the global compressive strain limit in the material 2 direction (eYc).
    Only used if OverrideMaterial is true.

properties.name: TensileLimitMaterialThreeDirection
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the global tensile strain limit in the out-of-plane direction (eZt).
    Only used if OverrideMaterial is true.

properties.name: CompressiveLimitMaterialThreeDirection
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the global compressive strain limit in the out-of-plane direction (eZc).
    Only used if OverrideMaterial is true.

properties.name: ShearLimitOneTwo
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the global in-plane shear strain limit (eSxy).
    Only used if OverrideMaterial is true.

properties.name: ShearLimitOneThree
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the global out-of-plane shear strain limit (eSxz).
    Only used if OverrideMaterial is true.

properties.name: ShearLimitTwoThree
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the global out-of-plane shear strain limit (eSyz).
    Only used if OverrideMaterial is true.

properties.doc: Gets or sets whether the simplified, 2D, or 3D Puck formulation is used.

properties.name: ConsiderInterFiberParallelStresses
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether inter-fiber failure will include the influence of the fiber parallel stresses.

properties.name: EvaluateFiberFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether fiber failure (pf) is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'pf'.

properties.name: FiberFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the fiber failure evaluation.

properties.name: EvaluateMatrixTensionFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether matrix tension failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'pmA'.

properties.name: MatrixTensionFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the matrix tension (pmA) failure evaluation.

properties.name: EvaluateMatrixCompressionFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether matrix compression failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'pmB'.

properties.name: MatrixCompressionFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the matrix compression (pmB) failure evaluation.

properties.name: EvaluateMatrixShearFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether matrix shear failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'pmC'.

properties.name: MatrixShearFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the matrix shear (pmC) failure evaluation.

properties.name: EvaluateDelamination
properties.doc:
Gets or sets whether delamination is evaluated. Only applies when three-dimensional
    evaluation is selected. The corresponding failure label is 'pd'.

properties.name: DelaminationWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the delamination (pd) evaluation.

properties.name: OverrideMaterial
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether the global Puck constants are used overriding material-specific constants.

properties.name: InclinationFactorTwoOnePositive
properties.doc: Gets or sets the p21(+) Puck constant.

properties.name: InclinationFactorTwoOneNegative
properties.doc: Gets or sets the p21(-) Puck constant.

properties.name: InclinationFactorTwoTwoPositive
properties.doc: Gets or sets the p22(+) Puck constant.

properties.name: InclinationFactorTwoTwoNegative
properties.doc: Gets or sets the p22(-) Puck constant.

properties.name: DegradationInitiationFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the degradation initiation factor s (0 < s < 1).

properties.name: DegradationResidualStrengthFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the degradation residual strength factor M (0 < M < 1).

properties.name: InterfaceWeakeningFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the interface weakening factor.

ShearCrimpingSettings.name: ShearCrimpingSettings
ShearCrimpingSettings.doc: Defines the configuration for the Face Sheet Crimping failure criterion for sandwich structures.

methods.name: Reset
methods.doc: Resets the settings to their default values.

properties.name: WeightingFactor
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the weighting factor for shear crimping failure.
    The corresponding failure label is 'sc'.

properties.name: CoreWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor of core material of crimping allowable.

properties.name: FaceSheetWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor of face sheets of crimping allowable.

TsaiHillSettings.name: TsaiHillSettings
TsaiHillSettings.doc: Defines the configuration for the Tsai-Hill failure criterion for reinforced materials.

methods.name: Reset
methods.doc: Resets the settings to their default values.

properties.name: FailureDimension
properties.doc:
Gets or sets whether the failure criterion is evaluated only in-plane (2D),
    or also in the out-of-plane direction (3D).

properties.name: WeightingFactor
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the weighting factor for the failure criterion.
    The corresponding failure label is 'th'.

TsaiWuSettings.name: TsaiWuSettings
TsaiWuSettings.doc: Defines the configuration for the Tsai-Wu failure criterion for reinforced materials.

methods.name: Reset
methods.doc: Resets the settings to their default values.

properties.name: FailureDimension
properties.doc:
Gets or sets whether the failure criterion is evaluated only in-plane (2D),
    or also in the out-of-plane direction (3D).

properties.name: WeightingFactor
properties.doc:
Gets or sets the weighting factor for the failure criterion.
    The corresponding failure label is 'tw'.

VonMisesSettings.name: VonMisesSettings
VonMisesSettings.doc: Defines the configuration for the Von Mises failure criterion for isotropic materials.

methods.name: Reset
methods.doc: Resets the settings to their default values.

properties.name: EvaluateStrainFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether strain failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'vMe'.

properties.name: StrainFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the strain failure (vMe) evaluation.

properties.name: EvaluateStressFailure
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether stress failure is evaluated. The corresponding failure label is 'vMs'

properties.name: StressFailureWeightingFactor
properties.doc: Gets or sets the weighting factor for the stress failure (vMs) evaluation.

properties.name: ConsiderInterlaminarNormalStresses
properties.doc: Gets or sets whether interlaminar normal stresses are evaluated.
